# The Mandalay Bay: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `Exios66/degen-llms` `80399bf` on 30 October 2026.

## Counts

379 line-start `def test_` functions in 52 files under `tests/`. This is a grep floor, not `pytest --co`. Node: 13 `scripts/smoke-test-*.mjs` and 5 `scripts/test-*-regressions.mjs`. CI loops over all of them, then runs the browser smoke test.

Python outside `docs/`: 27,389 lines. Tests: 5,170. Scripts: 6,801. `mandalay_bay`: 13,121. All of those are `wc -l`.

## What the README and changelog do not say

The source README still says "200+ tests" and no longer says "14 slot machines". The changelog ends at 1.2.2. Merged pull requests run through #160, and #158–#160 are not changelog entries yet. Content counts that were re-checked on 29 October (8 floors, 37 machines, 744 contracts) were not re-derived from the data files on this pass.

The Pages demo is a manual deploy and can lag main.

:::
